name: Capital Investment
summary: Trade (untrained). Requires a settlement with a Bank. Invest personal gp equal to the kingdom level's "Currency per Additional PC" (CRB Table 10-9). Crit: gain 4 Resource Dice RP. Success: 2 Resource Dice RP. Fail: 1d4 RP. Crit fail: Crime rises. Can also repay Tap Treasury without a roll.

name: Celebrate Holiday
summary: Folklore (untrained), basic check; DC +4 if celebrated last turn. Success: +1 circumstance to Loyalty checks until end of next turn, spend 1 Resource Die RP (crit: +2 and free). Fail: spend 1 Resource Die RP. Crit fail: -4 Resource Dice next turn, -1 to Loyalty checks.

name: Clandestine Business
summary: Intrigue (trained). DC = Control DC, +2 per consecutive turn used, -1 per turn skipped. Crit: 2 Resource Dice RP and 1d4 Luxuries. Success: one of those, +1 Unrest. Fail: 1 Resource Die RP, +1 Unrest, +1 Corruption. Crit fail: +1d6 Unrest, +2 Corruption, +1 other Ruin.

name: Craft Luxuries
summary: Arts (untrained). Spend 1 Resource Die RP, then basic check. Crit: 1d4 Luxury Commodities. Success: 1 Luxury. Crit fail: +1 Ruin.

name: Create a Masterpiece
summary: Arts (trained), basic check; once per turn. Success: +1 Fame/Infamy. Crit: also +1 Fame/Infamy next turn and 2 Resource Dice RP. Crit fail: lose 1 Fame/Infamy (or gain 1d4 Unrest).

name: Creative Solution
summary: Scholarship (untrained), basic check; fortune. Success: later this turn reroll one kingdom check with +2 circumstance (costs 1d4 RP; free on crit); if unused, gain 10 XP. Fail: lose 2d6 RP. Crit fail: also -1 to Culture checks next turn.

name: Establish Trade Agreement
summary: Trade (Boating if connected by river, Magic at master). Requires diplomatic relations. DC = higher of the group's Negotiation DC and Control DC. Success: trade agreement (crit: also 2 Resource Dice RP). Fail: pay 2 Resource Dice RP to succeed. Crit fail: +1 Unrest, -1 to Economy checks.

name: Focused Attention
summary: Any skill, DC 20 check. Success: another leader gains +2 circumstance to one check with that skill this turn.

name: Hire Adventurers
summary: Exploration (untrained). Spend 1 Resource Die RP; DC = Control DC adjusted by event level. Crit: end a continuous event. Success: +2 to resolve it next Event phase. Fail: cost rises to 2 Resource Dice. Crit fail: can no longer hire adventurers for this event.

name: Infiltration
summary: Intrigue (untrained), basic check. Spy on a target or on the kingdom. Success: vague info, or -1 Unrest. Crit: precise info, or -1d4 Unrest / -1 Ruin. Crit fail: -2 to all kingdom checks until end of next turn.

name: Pledge of Fealty
summary: Intrigue, Statecraft, or Warfare vs. the group's Negotiation DC. Crit: group joins and its hex is claimed (+10 XP, +1 Size). Success: group joins, spend 1 Resource Die RP. Fail: +1 Unrest, retry next turn. Crit fail: +2 Unrest, +1 Ruin, group never pledges.

name: Prognostication
summary: Magic (trained), basic check. Success: +1 to resolve random events this turn. Crit: roll the event twice and choose, +2 to resolve. Crit fail: automatic random event; GM picks from two rolls.

name: Provide Care
summary: Defense (untrained), basic check. Success: -1 Unrest. Crit: -1 Unrest and -1 Ruin. Crit fail: +1 Unrest or Ruin.

name: Purchase Commodities
summary: Trade (untrained). Spend 8 RP (Luxuries) or 4 RP (other), then basic check. Crit: 4 of the chosen + 2 of another (non-Luxury). Success: 2. Fail: 1. Crit fail: none.

name: Quell Unrest
summary: Arts, Folklore, Intrigue, Magic, Politics, or Warfare, basic check; once per turn, not the same skill as last turn. Crit: -1d6 Unrest. Success: -1 Unrest. Crit fail: +1d4 Unrest or +1 to two Ruins.

name: Recruit Army
summary: Army activity taken in the Leadership step. Warfare vs. Recruitment DC for a basic army, Statecraft for a specialized army. Success: recruit it (crit: efficient). Crit fail: +1 Unrest, no retry this turn.

name: Relocate Capital
summary: Industry (trained). Requires another settlement with a Castle, Palace, or Town Hall; uses all leaders' activities this turn. DC = Control DC + 5; not again for 3 turns. Success: +1 Unrest (none on crit). Fail: +1 Unrest, +1 to two Ruins. Crit fail: move fails, +1d4 Unrest, Ruins rise.

name: Repair Reputation
summary: Arts (Corruption), Trade (Crime), Engineering (Decay), or Intrigue (Strife) vs. Control DC + 2. Success: -1 to that Ruin. Crit: -2 and its ruin penalty -1. Fail: no retry on that Ruin for 1 turn. Crit fail: +1d4 Unrest, no retry for 3 turns.

name: Request Foreign Aid
summary: Statecraft (trained). Requires diplomatic relations; DC = group's Negotiation DC + 2. Success: 1 Resource Die RP or +2 to a check. Crit: +4 to a check and 2 Resource Dice RP. Fail: 1d4 RP next turn. Crit fail: +1d4 Unrest.

name: Rest and Relax
summary: Arts, Boating, Scholarship, Trade, or Wilderness, basic check; DC +4 if done last turn. Success: -1 Unrest. Crit: also +2 to your next Leadership activity. Crit fail: -2 to your next Leadership activity check.

name: Send Diplomatic Envoy
summary: Statecraft (trained) vs. the group's Negotiation DC (-4 and one degree worse if at war). Success: diplomatic relations (crit: also +2 to checks with them). Fail: +2 next turn. Crit fail: +1d4 Unrest, +1 Ruin, or pay 2 Resource Dice RP; no retry for 3 turns. First success: 60 XP milestone.

name: Supernatural Solution
summary: Your spellcasters try to resolve issues when mundane solutions just aren't enough. Attempt a basic check.

name: Abandon Hex
summary: Exploration or Wilderness, basic check (+1 DC per extra hex). Success: abandon, -1 Size per hex, +1 Unrest (crit: +1 RP per hex, no Unrest). Fail: +2 Unrest and DC 6 flat check or Squatters event. Crit fail: +3 Unrest and Bandit Activity event. Unrest doubles if a settlement is abandoned.

name: Build Roads
summary: Engineering (untrained). Hex must be claimed. Spend RP by terrain (double if a river crosses, adding a Bridge), then basic check. Success: roads in the hex. Crit: also one adjacent claimed hex. Crit fail: +1 Unrest.

name: Claim Hex
summary: Exploration, Intrigue, Magic, or Wilderness. Hex must be reconnoitered, adjacent, and cleared. Spend 1 RP, basic check. Success: claim it, +1 Size, +10 XP. Crit: also take another Region activity. Crit fail: -1 to Stability checks. Limit 1/turn (2 at level 4, 3 at level 9).

name: Clear Hex
summary: Engineering (spend RP by terrain) to prepare for a settlement or remove an improvement, or Exploration vs. the level-based DC to remove monsters/hazards. +2 DC if the hex is unclaimed. Crit: refund half the RP, or 2 Luxuries from monsters. Crit fail: +1 Unrest.

name: Establish Farmland
summary: Agriculture (untrained). Plains or hills in a settlement's influence. Plains: 1 RP vs. Control DC; hills: 2 RP vs. Control DC + 5. Success: 1 Farmland hex (crit: 2 adjacent). Crit fail: risk of Crop Failure events.

name: Establish Settlement
summary: Engineering, Industry, Politics, or Scholarship, basic check. Hex must be cleared with no settlement. Crit: spend 1d6 RP. Success: 3d6 RP. Fail: 6d6 RP. Crit fail (or can't pay): no settlement. Starts as a village.

name: Establish Work Site
summary: Engineering (untrained). Lumber camp (forest) or mine/quarry (hills, mountains). Spend RP by terrain, then basic check. Success: work site. Crit: doubled yields until end of next turn. Crit fail: +1 Unrest.

name: Fortify Hex
summary: Defense (untrained). Claimed hex without a settlement. Spend RP by terrain, then basic check. Success: fortification, -1 Unrest. Crit: also refund half the RP. Crit fail: +1 Unrest.

name: Gather Livestock
summary: Wilderness (untrained), basic check. Crit: 1d4 Food. Success: 1 Food. Crit fail: lose 1d4 Food (or +1 Unrest if none).

name: Go Fishing
summary: Boating (untrained). Requires a claimed hex with river or lake. Basic check. Crit: 1d4 Food. Success: 1 Food. Crit fail: +1 Unrest.

name: Harvest Crops
summary: Agriculture (untrained), basic check. Crit: 1d4 Food. Success: 1 Food. Crit fail: lose 1d4 Food (or +1 Unrest if none).

name: Irrigation
summary: Engineering (trained). Controlled hex next to a river or lake but without one. Spend RP by terrain, then basic check. Success: hex gains a river/lake feature (crit: also refund half the RP). Crit fail: +1 Unrest and a recurring Plague flat check until undone.

name: Build Structure
summary: Uses the structure's skill. Choose contiguous lots, pay the RP and Commodity cost, then check. Also repairs damaged structures (half cost, +2 item bonus). Crit: refund half the Commodities. Fail: retry next turn without paying again. Crit fail: lots fill with Rubble.

name: Demolish
summary: Engineering (untrained), basic check to clear one occupied lot. Crit: clear a whole multi-lot structure or recover 1d6 lumber/stone/ore. Fail: lot stays Rubble. Crit fail: +1 Unrest.
